queries.name: only Nisha requested a reprint
queries.sql: select requested_by from sql03_print_jobs where batch_id = 'B-17R'

queries.name: the original has exactly one sealed custody-in scan
queries.sql: select scanned_by from sql03_custody_scans where batch_id = 'B-17' and scan_type = 'CUSTODY_IN'
